extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic performance figures inspected: Figure 1, Figure 2, Figure 3, Figure 4. Figure 5 is DRIFTS/characterisation and was skipped. Figure 1b and 1c plot product yields Y(MeOH) and Y(CO), which are not available as fields in the target schema; only conversion/selectivity panels 1a and 1d were digitised. Figure 2 is primarily methanol-conversion/product-STY data (CO, CO2, DME, CH4, MF) rather than CO2-hydrogenation-to-methanol performance, and most plotted quantities have no target schema fields; it was not digitised except insofar as Figure 3 gives MeOH STY. Figure 4 plots log(rCO) versus log(pH2) for reaction-order determination; the target schema has no CO formation-rate field, so it was skipped. Values are approximate reads from marker centres/bar tops and carry qualifier '~'. For Figure 1a, individual GHSV assignments cannot be unambiguously read from the scatter plot, so GHSV is left null with the caption range noted.
